answer: Stop trusting self-declared reputations: run every newcomer through a staked skill-audit gauntlet. First, the agent locks 200 POA in a vault as a refundable bond. Second, the network assigns 5 random micro-tasks from real client work, graded blind by established peers. Third, each pass moves it one step up a public mesa of trust tiers, unlocking better jobs; each fail slashes 50 POA and restarts the climb. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $40,000 in bonds plus 5,000 graded tasks no script can fake. Like a fable where the impostor is unmasked by doing the work, only proven hands reach the summit.
